title: When Interfaces Speak: Data-Aware Generative UI Harness for Active Interaction
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实
missingSignals: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce UI-TAU Bench, a benchmark for active human-agent interaction through generated UI code, built on 10 real-world domain databases constructed from public data sources and based on Tau-Bench tool-use settings, with Lite (300 tasks) and Full (1,000 tasks) splits.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Natural language can impose cognitive overload, ambiguity, information chaos, and slow input for complex tasks; ephemeral generative UIs can present structured information and guide users toward task completion.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We address the first challenge with Dynamic UX, a lightweight package for dynamic interaction and reward collection in a single sandbox, and the second with Reward Auditor, a meta-reward mechanism that monitors reward distributions and distills diagnostic patterns into a shared rubric and scoring specification.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In a reviewer survey comparing communication channels, generated UIs reduce average dialogue rounds from 3.4 to 1.2.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We introduce UI-TAU Bench, a benchmark for active human-agent interaction through generated UI code, built on 10 real-world domain databases constructed from public data sources and based on Tau-Bench tool-use settings, with Lite (300 tasks) and Full (1,000 tasks) splits.
